jobs.prompt: Create ONE transparent collectible soda can for the Magic Drink hand-drawn cartoon game. Use attached Prism Peach can only as style-family reference. New flavor RIBBON RASPBERRY. Front view tall can with silver lid and bottom, bold crisp black ink outlines, cheerful cel colors, raspberry pink and cream label with purple accents. Adorable smiling cream ferret mascot twirling a long satin pink gymnastics ribbon into a heart, raspberries and little musical notes around it. Exact readable large text MAGIC DRINK and smaller RIBBON RASPBERRY. Match reference proportions and label hierarchy, full can centered, generous transparent margins. Flat ink-and-paint cartoon, no 3D shading, no background, no floor shadow.

Create a transparent game equipment icon, ONE ENCHANTED COASTER charm. Match the attached ornate gold and purple equipment charm reference family: crisp dark ink outline, rich gold trim, flat vibrant cel colors, tiny pink jewels, readable silhouette. A shallow purple saucer-shaped disk with a large pale golden five-point star on its top, seen at a three-quarter angle, magical little wings on its sides, a small gold hanging loop above. Feels like a portable magical stepping stone. Centered full charm with transparent padding. No letters, no words, no floor, no external drop shadow, no realistic metal shading.

Transparent sprite sheet for side-scrolling cartoon platform game. FOUR equally sized cells in ONE horizontal row, no grid lines, no text. Each cell contains the SAME hovering enchanted coaster platform, a WIDE SHALLOW HORIZONTAL ELLIPSE with purple top and golden rim, small golden star in center and tiny feather wings at each end. Platform is viewed almost edge-on, top ellipse 4:1 width to height; same size and center in each cell, plenty of transparent padding. Four sequential drawings: 1 intact solid coaster; 2 small thin visible cracks across purple top; 3 more cracks, loosening gold rim; 4 disintegrating purple and gold fragments retaining outline of platform. Flat cel painted cartoon with crisp dark ink outline, simple small-game-readable detail, no floor or shadow or background, no dangling charm loop. Use attached equipment icon only for matching palette and ornament family. Sheet width four times cell width.

Generate a transparent 4 by 4 sprite sheet, SIXTEEN equal square cells, no labels and no gridlines, for a 2D side scrolling cartoon game. Reference is the game's existing red clown: match its crisp ink outline, bright mostly flat cel colors, red curly hair, red outfit with yellow ruff, expressive friendly mischievous cartoon proportions, NO heavy shading, NO floor shadows. New enemy is a clown holding a red-and-cream striped umbrella as a forward shield. ALL standing poses face LEFT in exact side view, same size, clown torso center at 62% of each cell width, boots baseline at 88% cell height, full umbrella inside cell to LEFT of body, consistent registration. ROW ONE: four distinct walking poses carrying umbrella OPEN upright pointing LEFT, alternating stepping legs, compress passing stride, never slide boots in place. ROW TWO: sequence closing umbrella, fully closed umbrella wind-up, thrusting closed umbrella LEFT, recovering still closed. ROW THREE: reopening umbrella, open guard pose, blocking hit with open umbrella bent inward, relaxed open guard pose. ROW FOUR: defeat sequence: surprised clown with umbrella flipped inside out; stumbling backwards; sitting on ground with broken umbrella; little cartoon white smoke puffs and scattered red/cream umbrella scraps. Entire sheet transparent, each pose separated with transparent margins. No text or speech, no scenery, no dramatic lights. Draw all sixteen cells. Umbrella is sideways in front of clown, NOT over head.
